Summary proposal (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood will deliver the latest SOC 2 Type II report and standard bridge letter on request within 5 business days of a signed NDA/order finalization. We provide the report as a PDF (redactions limited to customer-specific PII).

- Evidence handoff: primary contact for evidence and staging access will be neha.kapoor@redwoodeval.com (Security Ops). Legal redline / contract language is attached (Redline_SecurityExhibit_v2.docx).

1) We share redline language for the Security Exhibit by EOD May 14 — attached.

3) If pen-test required pre-prod, schedule window (tentative) June 7–28; technical kickoff two weeks prior.
4) DocuSign routing after final redlines.

Notes / exceptions:
- For high-sensitivity engagements we can support onsite inspection with a pre-scheduled window; that needs a separate SOW.
- We limit access to production only under a scoped and time-boxed inspection unless an ongoing arrangement is contracted.

Hi all — looping in suggested contract language and a clearer evidence cadence. I kept the language tight so procurement can drop it into the Order Form / Security Exhibit with minimal back-and-forth.

Proposed redline snippets (to insert under Security Exhibit -> Audit & Evidence):
1) SOC 2 Reports: 
"Supplier shall provide Customer with its most recent SOC 2 Type II report and an accompanying bridge letter (if issued). Supplier will make these documents available via secure link within five (5) business days of Customer's written request or within five (5) business days following execution of the Order Form, whichever occurs later. Supplier may redact customer-specific personal data."

2) Penetration Testing / Inspection Rights: 
"Customer may, no more than once per 12-month period, conduct or engage a qualified third-party assessor to conduct a penetration test against Supplier's staging environment, subject to the following: (a) Supplier will provide reasonable assistance and a time-boxed access window not to exceed twenty-eight (28) calendar days from the agreed start date; (b) the parties will mutually agree on test scope and scheduling at least ten (10) business days in advance; (c) Supplier may require signed mutual non-disclosure and an approved rules-of-engagement prior to any testing; (d) Supplier will not permit testing against production systems unless separately agreed in writing and subject to additional controls."

3) Evidence Delivery: 
"Supplier will provide requested evidence (logs, configuration exports, audit traces and relevant artifacts) within ten (10) business days of the test completion or within ten (10) business days of the written request for SOC 2 artifacts. Any delays for third-party vendor-produced artifacts will be communicated within three (3) business days."

Operational note: if Clarity requires a shorter window for test execution or more frequent tests, we can consider a paid assurance addendum (Order Form line item) to accommodate that.

I attached a Word doc with tracked changes (same as Olga's). If this looks good, Olga — please send the tracked file to Jordan and procurement for redline.
